concept.title: What Is a Scene?
concept.shortdesc: A scene is a saved arrangement of sources that you can switch to instantly.

conbody.p: A scene is a named collection of one or more sources—windows, cameras, images, or other on-screen elements—arranged together on a canvas. Switching scenes changes everything visible on screen at once, instead of repositioning sources one at a time.
In short: sources are the pieces, a scene is the arrangement.
Most products let you build multiple scenes ahead of time and switch between them during a session or recording.
